attack_techniques: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: AS-REP Roasting (T1558.004)
attackers_goals: Crack account credentials by obtaining an easy-to-crack Kerberos ticket.
description: Multiple TGT requests for users that do not require Kerberos pre-authentication were observed. This is typically a sign of an AS-REP attack.
investigative_actions: Check who used the host at the time of the alert, to rule out a benign service or tool requesting weak Kerberos encryption.
